chunks: And when Jesus, son of Mary, said: 'O children of Israel, I am sent to you by God to confirm the Torah (sent) before me, and to give you good tidings of an apostle who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad.' Yet when he has come to them with clear proofs, they say: 'This is only magic.'
ai.seo_question: What did Jesus say about the Prophet Muhammad in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the prophetic status of Jesus (peace be upon him) and his explicit foretelling of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) as 'Ahmad', reinforcing the continuity of divine revelation. The rejection by the Children of Israel serves as a historical precedent for the eventual acceptance and rejection dynamics surrounding the final Prophet, highlighting the theme of divine clarity versus human obstinacy.
